info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Surface Properties API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2

params.name: weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2

params.name: weighted_surface_energy_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of weighted_surface_energy

params.name: weighted_surface_energy_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of weighted_surface_energy

params.name: surface_anisotropy_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of surface_anisotropy

params.name: surface_anisotropy_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of surface_anisotropy

params.name: shape_factor_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of shape_factor

params.name: shape_factor_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of shape_factor

params.name: weighted_work_function_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of weighted_work_function

params.name: weighted_work_function_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of weighted_work_function

params.name: has_reconstructed
params.description: Whether the entry has a reconstructed surface.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from SurfacePropDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `surfaces` `weighted_surface_energy_EV_PER_ANG2` `weighted_surface_energy` `surface_anisotropy` `pretty_formula` `shape_factor` `weighted_work_function` `has_reconstructed` `material_id` `structure`
